summary: The rate limiter now uses a versionstamped check-and-set retry loop, and the added concurrency regression confirms that only the configured five of fifty concurrent bumps succeed.

evidence: src/auth_store.ts:1395-1412 reads the bucket and commits the increment with `.check(result).set(...)`, retrying when the versionstamp conflict fails.
src/auth_store.ts:1400-1408 preserves `windowStart` while incrementing and refreshes expiry on successful commits, retaining the previous fixed-window semantics.
tests/bun_test.ts:67-78 drives 50 concurrent bumps against a limit of 5 and asserts that exactly 5 succeed.
